set.body: Extend the algebra to multiblock analysis. Add BlockPartition, block-local fitted preprocessors, BlockMap, MultiblockProjection, CrossProjection transfer between domains, and input restriction by global or block-local column ids. Acceptance: blockwise preprocessing composes with global column order; projectBlock is restrictInput, not a second projection mechanism; cross-domain transfer is typed and tested; mvproj multiblock and cross-projector fixtures are ported.
set.title: Multivar multiblock: block partitions and cross-projection
